reasons.correctness: Repository finder, service closeStaleResolvedTickets and cron job match the interface: property defaults, disabled no-op, failure caught and logged. Build and all 4/4 acceptance tests are green.
reasons.convention_fit: StaleTicketCloseCronJob uses @Autowired field injection on supportTicketService. The test run used the placeholder -Dtest=X, so the new test class and the SupportTicketService tests were never actually run. @SchedulerLock, property-driven cron and enabled flag are present.
reasons.design_fit: Clean layering: the job delegates to the service, the service owns the logic, the repository uses a derived query. The field-injected dependency is hidden from the constructor, which a reviewer would ask to change.
reasons.test_quality: The only test class, StaleTicketCloseCronJobUnitTest, covers the cron job's enabled, disabled and failure paths. closeStaleResolvedTickets (cutoff, status change to CLOSED, save, count) has no unit test. The happy-path test only verifies the service call.
reasons.graph_use: One generic query (MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.file_path LIMIT 1) did not locate the support package, its dependents or an example job. DeferredDeletionCronJob was found and read outside the graph.
